verdict.rationale: Grafana exposes a documented public HTTP API confirmed by a live OpenAPI spec (grafana-probe-3), plus provisioning/as-code docs and a CLI for automation (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-26, grafana-probe-5), and even an official MCP server and llms.txt for AI-agent access (grafana-docs-7, grafana-probe-4, grafana-probe-1). This gives strong first-party and probe-verified evidence of a documented, machine-drivable API surface. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of API completeness/stability and rate-limit/versioning details.
